hero.headline:
Give your music to the world.
Without the overhead.
hero.subtext: We are an independent team building straightforward, automated release tools for bedroom producers and indie artists.

struggle.heading: Staring at a blank screen kills your momentum.
struggle.bullet1_text: But spending the next day stressing over album names and formatting artwork kills your creative high.
struggle.bullet2_text: right when you should be celebrating your music.
struggle.highlight_text: We instantly compress your entire post-production checklist into a distribution-ready asset package.

vibe.heading: Give us 15 seconds. We map the vibe.
vibe.description: Upload a brief snippet of your track. Our app analyzes frequencies, rhythms, and tempos to generate concept art and text titles that perfectly match the soul of your sound.

manifesto.heading: No accounts. No forcing. Just focus on the music.
manifesto.row1_text: and data-harvesting setups just as much as you do.
manifesto.row2_text: You don't need a profile, password, or credit card to fully process your music layout results here.
manifesto.row3_text: Everything we have right now—and our core asset pipelines down the line—will remain free forever. Everything is optimized for the community.

card1.title: The Genreless Problem
card1.bullet1_text: , but experimental music often defies classification.
card1.bullet2_text: We scan your frequency weights to find official commercial tags that slide past distributor review blocks safely.

card2.title: Anti-AI Workarounds
card2.bullet1_text: on raw, unedited AI art and metadata formats.
card2.bullet2_text: We pass all graphics through a multi-layer styling system so your final assets look clean and fully compliant.

futurePlans.heading: What we are building next
futurePlans.title: Vibe-Driven Smart Promotion Engine
futurePlans.description: We are developing a tool to automatically scan your track's specific sound waves and match it to curated music niches, custom target playlists, and aesthetic visual content styles to make promotion easier.

email.heading: Don't miss an opportunity.
email.subcaption: Follow our email list only if you want to be the first to know when new modules and tools drop. No spam, no marketing trash. Completely optional.

aboutUs.footer_headline:

Let your sound lead.
